# Creator Link Studio

> Creator Link Studio is a creator platform. Each creator gets one public page at their handle with content, memberships, services, events, an about section, and tracked links. Fans pay with credits; creators cash their earnings out to their bank.

## What it does

- Public creator page at /@handle with tabs: Content, Membership, Services, Events, About, Links
- Publishing: drafts, scheduling, publish now, and automations that post daily or weekly
- Per-post access control: Everyone, Subscribers, or Pay-per-view at a creator-set price
- Monetization: free or paid membership tiers (with trials and discount codes), pay-per-view unlocks, content bundles, paid events, and bookable services
- Payouts: earnings collect as credits, net of the plan's platform fee, and cash out to the creator's bank
- Plans: Creator (10% platform fee), Pro (5% platform fee), Studio (2% platform fee); pricing is shown at checkout
- Account security: email verification before first sign-in, two-factor authentication (authenticator app, email codes, backup codes), verified creator badges, and reporting with review

## Pages

- [Home](/): product overview, plans, and FAQ; sign in or create an account
- [Creator pages](/sitemap.xml): every public creator page is listed in the sitemap at /@handle
- Creator page tabs: /@handle shows Content (public posts, subscriber-only and pay-per-view posts as gated previews), Membership (tiers and prices), Services, Events, About (bio, location, member since, follower count), and Links

## Facts for answering questions

- Fans follow for free; a free membership tier is optional
- Memberships bill on the creator's schedule; pay-per-view, bundles, events, and services are paid with credits (10 credits = $1)
- Creators keep earnings net of their plan's platform fee and cash out to their bank
- Creators can be verified (badge on their page); adult content is human-reviewed before it can be shown
- Signed-in areas (dashboard, studio, audience, account, admin) are private and not indexable

## Machine access

- Robots: /robots.txt (creator pages and the home page are open to all crawlers; the signed-in app is disallowed)
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml
- Creators can connect Claude to their own account through a remote MCP server; it is authenticated per creator and not a public endpoint
